summary: Generated Compose files give the container 60 s to stop, so LMCache can write its checkpoints
compatibility: Generated Compose files now set stop_grace_period: 60s. A container without an external cache still stops in seconds. For docker run with CACHE_MODE=lmcache, pass --stop-timeout 60 as the README shows.
details: With Docker's default 10 s stop timeout, LMCache's shutdown (finishing the checkpoint stores the model is still copying, then writing checkpoints that are only in RAM) was cut short once CACHE_MODE=lmcache was added to a generated Compose file.
